title.en: Used to: when I was a child

ex.t: Avant, je jouais au football tous les jours.
ex.ko: 나는 어릴 때 매일 축구를 하곤 했어요.
ex.en: I used to play football every day when I was a child.

ex.t: Nous habitions dans un petit village.
ex.en: We lived in a small village.

ex.ko: 나는 자전거를 타고 학교에 가곤 했어요.
ex.en: I used to go to school by bike.
I had a lot of toys.

ex.t: Je regardais des dessins animés chaque matin.
ex.ko: 나는 매일 아침 만화를 보곤 했어요.
ex.en: I used to watch cartoons every morning.

ex.ko: 나는 더 이상 거기 안 살아요.
ex.en: I don't live there any more.

ex.t: Autrefois, les gens écrivaient des lettres.
ex.en: In the past people wrote letters.

explain.ko: 지금은 사라진 과거의 습관과 상태는 반과거(imparfait)로 말합니다. 'avant', 'autrefois', 'quand j'étais enfant'과 함께 자주 쓰입니다. 지금은 달라졌다고 말할 때는 ne … plus를 씁니다: je n'habite plus là-bas.
explain.en: Use the imperfect for past habits and states that are no longer true. It often goes with avant, autrefois and quand j'étais enfant. Say that things have changed with ne … plus: je n'habite plus là-bas.

head: 표현 / Structure
예 / Exemple
rows: Je jouais au football tous les jours.
Il ne portait pas de lunettes.
J'habitais là-bas. Je n'habite plus là-bas.

notes.ko: 습관 = imparfait, 한 번의 일 = passé composé.
notes.en: Habit = imperfect; one-off event = passé composé.
Avant and autrefois mark the past.

lines.t: Où habitais-tu quand tu étais enfant ?

trans.en: (Question) Where did you live when you were a child?

lines.t: Que faisais-tu quand tu étais enfant ?

trans.en: (Question) What did you use to do when you were a child?

lines.t: Quels dessins animés regardais-tu quand tu étais enfant ?
Je regardais des dessins animés avec des animaux. Je n'en regarde plus.
Moi aussi. Et j'allais à l'école à vélo.

trans.ko:
A: 어릴 때 어떤 만화를 보곤 했어?
B: 나는 동물 만화를 보곤 했어. 지금은 안 봐.
A: 나도 그랬어. 그리고 자전거를 타고 학교에 갔어.
B: 나는 걸어서 학교에 가곤 했어.
trans.en:
A: What cartoons did you use to watch when you were a child?
B: I used to watch animal cartoons. I don't watch them now.
A: Me too. And I used to go to school by bike.
B: I used to walk to school.

lines.t: Quand j'étais enfant, j'habitais dans un petit village. Les voisins étaient tous gentils. Je jouais dehors avec mes amis tous les jours. Maintenant, j'habite en ville, donc je n'habite plus là-bas.

trans.ko: 나는 어릴 때 작은 마을에 살곤 했어요. 이웃들은 모두 친절했어요. 나는 매일 친구들과 밖에서 놀곤 했어요. 지금은 도시에 살아서 더 이상 거기 안 살아요.
trans.en: When I was a child, I used to live in a small village. The neighbours were all kind. I used to play outside with my friends every day. Now I live in a city, so I don't live there any more.

lines.t: Oui, jusqu'à l'âge de dix ans.

trans.ko:
직원: 예전에 이 도시에 살았어요?
손님: 네, 열 살까지 살았어요.
직원: 학교는 어떻게 다녔어요?
손님: 자전거를 타고 다녔어요.
trans.en:
Clerk: Did you use to live in this city?
Guest: Yes, until I was ten.
Clerk: How did you get to school?
Guest: I used to go by bike.

questions.q: Le client habitait ici jusqu'à ______ ans

items.passage:
1) Je ___ au football tous les jours.
2) Nous ___ dans un petit village.
3) Je n'habite ___ là-bas.

trans.ko: 1) 나는 어릴 때 매일 축구를 하곤 했어요. 2) 우리는 작은 마을에 살았어요. 3) 나는 더 이상 거기 안 살아요.
trans.en: 1) I used to play football every day when I was a child. 2) We used to live in a small village. 3) I don't live there any more.

questions.q: Je ___ au football tous les jours.

items.passage: Quand j'étais enfant, j'(1) dans un petit village. Je jouais dehors avec mes amis tous les (2). Maintenant, j'habite en ville, donc je n'habite (3) là-bas.

trans.ko: 나는 어릴 때 작은 마을에 살곤 했어요. 나는 매일 친구들과 밖에서 놀곤 했어요. 지금은 도시에 살아서 더 이상 거기 안 살아요.
trans.en: When I was a child, I used to live in a small village. I used to play outside with my friends every day. Now I live in a city, so I don't live there any more.

items.passage:
MOT À UN AMI
Quand j'étais enfant, j'allais à l'école à vélo.
Maintenant, je prends le bus.

trans.ko:
친구에게 쓴 메모
어릴 때 나는 자전거를 타고 학교에 가곤 했어. 지금은 버스를 타.
trans.en:
NOTE TO A FRIEND
When I was a child, I used to go to school by bike. Now I take the bus.

items.passage: Quand Tom était enfant, il habitait dans un petit village. Il jouait au football tous les jours. Maintenant, il habite dans une grande ville.

trans.ko: 톰은 어릴 때 작은 마을에 살았어요. 그는 매일 축구를 하곤 했어요. 지금 그는 큰 도시에 살아요.
trans.en: When Tom was a child, he lived in a small village. He used to play football every day. Now he lives in a big city.
